subject: Scope consolidation: engineering cluster rebalancing & review cadence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Scope consolidation: engineering cluster rebalancing & review cadence

Team —

I’m sharing a proposed structure for the inference engineering clusters that I discussed with infra leads last week. This is an intentional consolidation (two small pods -> one cluster) to reduce duplicated ownership and shorten cross-pod handoffs. High level:

- Move Pod A (Serving) and Pod B (Edge Runtime) into a single “Inference Serving Cluster” reporting to a single engineering manager.
- Create two functional leads under the manager: Runtime Lead (focus: latency & kernel selection) and Delivery Lead (focus: rollouts, rollbacks, SLAs).
- Retitle the SRE role to Platform Reliability Lead for those owning cross-cluster KV cache and batching infra.
- Keep product owners (Monica) aligned to feature areas; we’ll nominate a single product liaison for the cluster.

Concerns I know are likely: impact on current IC career ladders, manager spans, and customer-facing SLAs during the transition. My ask: please review the attached draft-org-chart-v1.pdf and the short role-map I sketched, and call out any blockers by EOD Thursday so we can iterate before leadership review next Tuesday.

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 22–27: feedback window and role mapping
- Nov 30: leadership review and approval
- Dec 7: comms to impacted employees + 1:1s begin

Specific asks:
1) Laura — can you validate product ownership handoffs (customer-impact list) and whether any contracts need a heads-up?
2) Marcus — estimate headcount delta / potential backfills and any budget requests.
3) Kimberly — confirm HR constraints on title changes and suggested approach to calibrate performance reviews for folks whose scopes widen.

Attachment: draft-org-chart-v1.pdf (diagram, v1)

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scope consolidation: engineering cluster rebalancing & review cadence

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear outline. I’m broadly supportive of consolidation (reduces overhead) but two quick notes:

- Product ownership: we need a short matrix showing current project leads and which customer SLAs could be affected in Q4 (I’ll add this to the doc).
- Feature handoffs: we must avoid a blackout window during the final rollout; recommend we keep a small on-call rotation from each legacy pod for first 6 weeks post-merge.

I’ll drop a short customer-impact list into the Drive link by Tuesday morning.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scope consolidation: engineering cluster rebalancing & review cadence

Quick pass from staffing/budget perspective:

- Headcount: if we consolidate manager roles we can avoid one open manager hire in Q1 but will need to budget for two lead IC roles (Runtime + Delivery). Net headcount impact: +1 IC over 2027 baseline to cover increased ownership breadth.
- Backfills: two mid-level ICs currently in Pod B will need clear career development pathways; I’ve attached a role-map.xlsx with suggested career steps and leveling notes.
- Budget: propose a one-time $18k uplift for cross-training and a ~4-week ramp overlap for knowledge transfer (estimate included in spreadsheet).

Attachment: role-map.xlsx (staffing & costing draft)

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scope consolidation: engineering cluster rebalancing & review cadence

Soojin/Team —

HR notes and constraints:

- Title changes: we can retitle roles but must preserve existing compensation bands unless a promotion or market adjustment is approved. Any promotion must be handled through People Ops early to honor notice periods and budget cycles.
- Performance review alignment: for folks whose scope expands, we should run a short calibration window — managers submit impact statements and direct managers meet for a 2-hour calibration on Dec 10.
- Communication cadence: recommend a two-phase comms plan — 1) initial notice to impacted employees with 1:1s scheduled the following week; 2) company-wide FAQ and an AMA after leadership approval. I’ve attached an org-comms-template.docx that you can reuse.

Legal: ensure customer contracts with change-of-control or service scope clauses are flagged (Laura to confirm).

Attachment: org-comms-template.docx

Happy to host calibration sessions; let me know preferred dates.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Scope consolidation: engineering cluster rebalancing & review cadence

Thanks all — good input and timely. Short summary and next steps: 

- Decisions: proceed with formation of “Inference Serving Cluster” with one manager + two functional leads. We will not change compensation bands without separate approvals (Kimberly confirmed).
- Action items:
  * Laura: add customer-impact matrix to Drive by Nov 26 (IN PROGRESS)
  * Marcus: finalize role-map.xlsx cost sheet and proposed headcount delta by Nov 27
  * Kimberly: schedule People Ops calibration 2-hour block on Dec 10 and share comms template updates
  * Monica: nominate product liaison by Nov 30

- Meeting: I’m scheduling a 60-minute alignment review for Tuesday, Dec 1 at 10:00 AM PT for leadership sign-off (calendar invite forthcoming).

Please confirm you can deliver your items by Friday EOD. If you have concerns about team morale or performance-review timing, flag them in thread or DM Kimberly — we’ll keep 1:1s private.
